bibl.title: Constantine Simonides and Papyrus Fragments of Gemistus Pletho's Μαγικὰ λόγια τῶν ἀπὸ Ζωροάστρου μάγων.
bibl.seg: Rachel Yuen-Collingridge, Constantine Simonides and Papyrus Fragments of Gemistus Pletho's Μαγικὰ λόγια τῶν ἀπὸ Ζωροάστρου μάγων.
bibl.note: Identifies the probable source for one of Constantine Simonides' papyrus forgeries 'discovered' in the Egyptological collection of Joseph Mayer in Liverpool. The papyrus forgery reproduces sections of Gemistus Pletho's fifteenth collection of sayings attributed to Zoroaster. - Appendix I: Concordance of fragment numbers; - Appendix II: Manuscripts.
